apkPermissionBody: Allow Cindy to install apps in Android settings, then return here to continue installing.
apkReady: The update is downloaded. If you cancelled installation, tap Install Update to open the installer again.

apkError.download: The update could not be downloaded. Check your connection and available storage, then retry.
apkError.install: The update could not be installed. Retry to download a fresh package and open the installer.
apkError.unavailable: This installed version does not support in-app installation. Install a newer app package to use this feature.

installHintBody: After tapping Install in the system dialog, return to the home screen to watch the download progress. The system replaces the current version automatically once the download finishes.
openInstallFailedBody: Copy the install address manually and open it in Safari.
bundleAvailableBody: A new version is available. Download and install the full app package to update.
upToDateBody: You already have the latest app package.
checkFailedBody: Couldn't reach the update server. Try again later.
